name: Cicero's Hoard
purpose: A local workspace that turns a brief and source documents into an editable presentation: outline, slides with speaker notes, per-slide review and revisions, themes, and export to PPTX (native text and charts), PDF, HTML and Markdown, for assistants over MCP.
notes: Keep the app running (python -m cicero_hoard): the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server, never opens the database, and starts the app itself when it is not answering. Tools that change or delete something: deck_create, deck_update, deck_delete, source_add, source_remove, outline_generate, outline_update, slides_generate, slide_update, slide_regenerate, slide_approve, slide_revert, slide_add, slide_delete, slides_reorder, deck_theme (with a theme), deck_export (writes a file), slide_image. Deletes need confirm=true and only when the user asks; outline_generate, outline_update and slides_generate replace what the outline or the draft slides held. Figures on slides must come from the sources; deck_check lists the ones that do not. Approving a slide is the person's decision. PDF export needs Chromium (python -m playwright install chromium); without it deck_export with format pdf fails with pdf_unavailable and the other formats still work. slide_image needs the family image studio and fails with image_studio_unavailable otherwise.
